# Sun Optics

> Sun Optics is a luxury eyewear house in India. It designs handcrafted sunglasses and optical frames in Japanese β-titanium and Italian Mazzucchelli acetate, fitted with lenses that block 100% of UVA/UVB. Boutiques in New Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru offer free eye tests and 3D face-scan fittings.

## Key facts
- Category: luxury sunglasses, optical (prescription) frames, prescription lenses
- Materials: β-titanium, Mazzucchelli acetate; 24-step hand finish; frames under 28 g on average
- Lenses: 100% UVA/UVB (UV400); polarised, mirror, photochromic and prescription options; tints Bronze, G-15 Green, Ocean Mirror, Rosé, Smoke Grey
- Warranty: 2 years against manufacturing defects; 14-day return on unworn non-prescription pieces
- Orders: there is no online checkout. Customers enquire and order through WhatsApp from any product page.
- Delivery: insured shipping across India
- Currency: INR (₹), prices include GST
- Contact: hello@sunoptics.in
